design_status: exploratory historical evaluation on already-viewed 2021-2026 ECB data

data.transformation: 100 * log(rate_t / rate_previous_publication), currency units per EUR
data.standardization: per-asset training-only standard deviation, ddof=1; divide without demeaning
data.download: forbidden; use exact previously frozen archive only

training.sampling: with replacement, uniform probability over four assets, not exact per-batch asset balance; target index uniform from64 through last training return; exactly balanced context schedule per epoch
training.matching: independent NumPy generator reset to paired seed for each architecture; matching prefixes, possibly different stopping epochs
training.selection: absolute minimum mean 2019 Gaussian NLL over both contexts and all assets; min_delta applies only to patience
training.exclusions: none; abort and diagnose any numerical failure

calibration.strong_streams: both neural architectures context64 all five seeds, and every classical stream, each asset separately
calibration.max_scale_rule: sqrt(3)*max(abs(return)/issued_scale) over2019, separately for every stream
calibration.replay: each asset-specific stream begins2020; first128 observations common reporting burn-in, rolling/ACI updates from their own required window; author methods update from first observation; continue state into2021 without reset
calibration.archive: originally issued context-specific denominators; strictly earlier than prediction date
calibration.coverage_guarantee: none; max_scale is heuristic and scores are dependent/nonstationary

classical.fit: one training-only fit per asset; frozen stage2_baselines implementation and GARCH multistart rule
classical.state: run each fitted recursion over complete observed return chronology once, then slice; no boundary resets

analysis.resampling: paired circular date blocks; all assets, fits, methods and mechanism cells share date draws; average five fitted seeds before equal asset averaging
analysis.multiplicity: all intervals exploratory and unadjusted; conditional on saved fits, not training-population uncertainty
analysis.units: coverage is unchanged; width/IS reported raw per asset and divided by that asset's train-only standard deviation for pooled comparisons
analysis.predeclared_comparisons: context64 GRU-minus-GARCH, TCN-minus-GARCH, GRU-minus-TCN for each identical calibrator native/rolling32/rolling128/aci128/sfogd/saocp
analysis.mechanism: J_FX=D(64,64)-D(16,16); D(a,b)=IS(a,b,128)-IS(a,b,32) on the actual historical sequence, without event-minus-control subtraction; retain both routes and third-order term
analysis.reporting: all methods, all assets, all five seeds; calendar-year summaries explicitly label partial2026; no event/regime selection

predeclared_display.core_table: context64 GRU/TCN and GARCH; native and rolling128; coverage and normalized interval score, all fits
predeclared_display.selection: fixed before any new FX result; all coverage/width/asset/year/seed data retained in full CSVs

execution.overwrite: refuse existing output directories; no silent resume or replacement
execution.scope: new local CPU FX procedure; no paid HPC training or GPU scientific jobs
execution.resource_decision: CPU chosen before any new FX outcome or training to avoid uncertain HPC charges; model count and scientific protocol unchanged
execution.gpu_runtime_smoke: separate prior environment check only, not a prerequisite or scientific result for this FX experiment

limitations: Already-viewed historical evaluation; no independent confirmation or test-selected model/rule
Four EUR-cross currencies share dates and denominator; no IID asset or seed pseudo-replication
Reference rates are informational, not executable trading prices or realized volatility
Historical ZIP is not a point-in-time revision-vintage dataset
Zero-mean Gaussian likelihood and log-scale clipping may be misspecified; no guaranteed90% coverage
2019 checkpoint/calibrator-scale preparation is retrospective; 2020 replay is unscored initialization
Bootstrap assumes useful within-block dependence approximation and is not valid under arbitrary shift
J_FX is a descriptive computational contrast, not simulated matched-shock J, causal mediation, or model ranking
Different early stopping means architectures denote whole training procedures
No trading performance, deployment, novelty or A+ guarantee
